ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms golden paths, reviewed diffs and the auto-accept flag are declared; it does not compare snapshots.
offer: Review golden output differences against intended behavior before accepting them. Automatically updating snapshots turns the implementation output into its own expected result.

minimal.reason: List the golden files under test. Unlisted snapshots drift unnoticed, so name each path.

mid.reason: Record the diffs reviewed against intended behavior. An unreviewed update accepts the implementation as truth, so cite the review.

maximal.reason: Set automatic snapshot acceptance to false. Updating snapshots blindly makes output its own expectation, so require a human decision.
